home.title: An intelligent platform for Islamic inheritance calculation
home.subtitle: An educational system for calculating estate distribution according to the rules of Islamic inheritance law.
home.notice: This project is for educational and calculation purposes only and does not replace consulting a qualified scholar.

features.accuracyDesc: The system calculates heirs’ shares according to the rules of Islamic inheritance, considering exclusion, awl, and radd.
features.schoolsDesc: The system follows the rules adopted by the majority of Islamic scholars in inheritance matters.
features.clarityDesc: Results are presented clearly, including percentages, amounts, and reasons for entitlement.

howItWorks.title: How does the system work?
howItWorks.step1Desc: Specify cash, gold, real estate, or land to be distributed.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Select the deceased’s gender and accurately enter the existing heirs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Display heirs’ shares with percentages, amounts, and jurisprudential evidence.

home.footer: This project was built for learning and practical application of inheritance rules. In real cases, consulting scholars is always recommended.

rules.title: Explanation of Islamic Inheritance Rules
rules.subtitle: A simplified overview of the main rules used by the system to calculate inheritance.

whatIs.title: What is Ilm al-Fara'id?
whatIs.desc: Ilm al-Fara'id is the science that explains how an estate is distributed among rightful heirs according to Islamic law.

fard.title: Fixed-share heirs
fard.mother: Mother: inherits one-third or one-sixth depending on the presence of descendants or siblings.
fard.father: Father: inherits one-sixth with descendants, or the remainder as an agnate.
fard.spouse: Husband or wife: each has fixed shares depending on the presence of descendants.
fard.daughters: Daughters: inherit one-half or two-thirds when there is no son.

asabah.title: Agnatic inheritance (Asabah)
asabah.desc: Agnatic inheritance means taking the remainder of the estate after fixed shares, where a male receives twice the share of a female.

blocking.title: Exclusion (Blocking)
blocking.father: The presence of the father excludes siblings from inheritance.
blocking.sons: The presence of a son excludes brothers and sisters from inheritance.

awlRadd.title: Awl and Radd
awlRadd.awl: Awl: If the fixed shares exceed the estate, all shares are proportionally reduced.
awlRadd.radd: Radd: If part of the estate remains, it is returned to the fixed-share heirs (except spouses).

rules.notice: This explanation is for educational purposes only and is not a religious ruling (fatwa).
